keySpecs: Vceo: 25V, Ic: 700mA continuous (1.5A peak), hFE: 85 to 300, Ptot: 1 Watt (TO-92), Transition frequency: 150 MHz.
useCase: Direct microcontroller driving of 5V DC toy motors, electromagnetic buzzers, and relay coils up to 700mA.

name: S8550 PNP Transistor (700mA)
primaryFunction: High current 700mA PNP transistor, complementary to S8050 for low-voltage push-pull power amplification.
keySpecs: Vceo: -25V, Ic: -700mA, Ptot: 1W, hFE: 85 to 300, Complementary to S8050.
useCase: Class B push-pull audio output stage with S8050, high-side power supply switching.

name: L6205 Dual Full-Bridge Driver
pinout: PowerDIP-20 / SO-20: 2 complete DMOS full-bridges with independent direction and PWM inputs and current sense resistors
primaryFunction: DMOS dual full-bridge motor driver IC with non-dissipative overcurrent protection and thermal shutdown.
keySpecs: Operating voltage: 8V to 52V, Total RMS current: 2.8A (5.6A peak), Low RDS(on): 0.3 Ω, Switching frequency up to 100 kHz.
useCase: Driving two separate DC motors or one bipolar stepper motor in robotic arms and 3D printers.

name: BTS7960B Single Half-Bridge 43A IC
pinout: TO-263-7 (D2PAK-7): 1-GND, 2-IN(Logic Input), 3-INH(Inhibit / Enable), 4-OUT(High current half-bridge switch node), 5-SR(Slew rate resistor), 6-IS(Current sense diagnostic), 7-VS(Supply voltage up to 28V)
primaryFunction: Fully integrated high-current half bridge for motor drive applications combining one p-channel high side and one n-channel low side MOSFET.
keySpecs: Maximum current: 43A peak, Low on-state resistance: 16 mΩ @ 25°C, Current limitation level: 55A, Diagnostic current feedback.
useCase: Combined in pairs to form the ubiquitous 43A BTS7960 H-Bridge module for high-torque electric vehicles.
